description:
## [1.1.0](https://github.com/heyymichii/michii-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-10-11)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Recommend LinkedIn 4.1.1255.1 instead of 4.1.1258 ([163bed7](https://github.com/heyymichii/michii-patches/commit/163bed7f8ba1e4a92dda5282b9e26f5d0ef601a5))
* Translate the settings and explain how to open them ([2588e6a](https://github.com/heyymichii/michii-patches/commit/2588e6ac101538ee7c82858c7c691ad3a1b02c94)), closes [#2](https://github.com/heyymichii/michii-patches/issues/2)

### ✨ New Features

* Add a diagnostic report for bug reports ([30dbd93](https://github.com/heyymichii/michii-patches/commit/30dbd9386bfeaea09ce40885d9b6621dcc8d2552))
* Support LinkedIn 4.1.1259 and always show the settings shortcut ([3ba29a2](https://github.com/heyymichii/michii-patches/commit/3ba29a236136b3d8ac3d2a48bdf8a3dab039c7d0))

patches.name: Block tracking
patches.description: Adds an option (off by default) to stop sending most LinkedIn analytics events.

patches.name: Disable double-tap like
patches.description: Stops double tapping a post or photo from liking it.

patches.name: Download media
patches.description: Adds a download button to the full screen photo and video viewer.

patches.name: Feed filters
patches.description: Adds optional filters (off by default, turned on in Michii Patches): focus mode, celebrations, job cards, reposts, video posts, the "New posts" pill and "See translation".

patches.name: Hide Premium upsells
patches.description: Removes Premium and AI upsell cards and banners, including on profiles and the Me panel.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes promoted (sponsored) posts from the feed.

patches.name: Hide promoted jobs
patches.description: Removes promoted job listings from the Jobs tab and job search.

patches.name: Hide suggested posts
patches.description: Removes "Suggested" posts from outside your network from the feed.

patches.name: Messaging
patches.description: Hides sponsored messages, and adds an optional ghost mode that does not send typing indicators or read status.

patches.name: Open links directly
patches.description: Opens external links without LinkedIn's safety/go warning page.

patches.name: Sanitize share links
patches.description: Removes tracking parameters from LinkedIn links when they are copied or shared.
